summary: Tested Notes CRUD (backend + UI) and Admin disable/reinstate flows. All 5 backend pytest tests pass. UI e2e verifies: Notes create/edit/delete via left-nav Notes page works; Admin can toggle bob@stitches.app between 'Disable Account' and 'Reinstate Account' with 'Disabled' badge appearing/disappearing; disabled user login returns 403 with expected message; reinstated user can login again. Bob left in reinstated state.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py update_note: updates dict is built via model_dump() which includes None fields excluded correctly, but title/content default to empty string via `or 'Untitled'` only in create — updates can overwrite with empty strings. Minor.
Notes DELETE endpoint returns {ok: true} even if the note doesn't belong to the caller (silent no-op). This correctly protects data but does not signal 404 — acceptable but could be tightened.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded accounts; bob reinstated after test
